threads.body:
The same attribute now ends up with two different conditions. This ref and the `invoke_agent` one below still say `When available.`, while the new `invoke_workflow` ref spells out exactly when to set it. You can see it in the generated docs: the workflow table puts its condition in a footnote, every other `gen_ai.conversation.id` row just says `When available.` inline.

Now that the shared note lives on the attribute itself, it'd be good for the requirement level to read the same way everywhere. Same change for the `invoke_agent` ref around line 226.

```suggestion
          conditionally_required: If and only if the instrumented library has one readily available, or the user application provides one through OpenTelemetry context or library-specific mechanisms.
```
